name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta province, northwest Argentina. The Diablillos project hosts one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally, with Measured and Indicated resources totalling approximately 248 million ounces of contained silver and 2.54 million ounces of contained gold. The company completed a Pre-Feasibility Study in December 2024 showing a US$747M NPV and is now advancing a Feasibility Study, with strategic backing from Kinross Gold and Eric Sprott.
